name: 101-robust-skip-back-during-stall
description: Robustness: segment 4 renders for 9 s; the playhead runs dry at the end of 3 (Buffering; Chrome stops about 70 ms short of the buffered end, so 3 is still the reported segment). A 10 s skip back lands in buffered audio of 3 and must play at once (Playing in 3); 4 arrives while 3 plays and follows without a gap.
